messages:
emma: Hey everyone — first day! Trying to get a hosted sandbox API key but the console shows 0 quota. Where do I find the dev API keys and how do sandbox quotas/rate limits work?
devex: Welcome, emma :tada: Quick guide: Console -> Settings -> API Keys. Sandbox keys are in the "Sandbox" tab. They start with `sk-sandbox-...`.
emma: I see a key but requests keep getting 429. Is there a default rate limit for sandbox?
sam: Sandbox limits are conservative — default token quota is 100k tokens/day and a burst rate of ~60 requests/min (roughly 1 rps sustained). If you're doing big evals, you'll hit 429s.
emma: Ah okay. I'm running a small prompt loop for local testing, maybe too chatty. Any suggestions to avoid 429s?
devex: Two quick options: 1) Reduce parallelism or add a short retry/backoff. 2) Use the dedicated dev key flow if you need higher burst for short experiments — request via the quota form.
infra-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder: Do NOT paste your full secret key in public channels. Use 1Password or the internal vault.
emma: oops thanks, I didn't paste it here but good reminder. Where's the quota request form?
devex: https://internal.redwood.ai/quota-request — pick "sandbox increase" and include use case, expected tokens/day, and duration. For temporary spikes choose the "ephemeral dev key" option and tag @devex.
emma: What's an ephemeral dev key?
sam: Ephemeral keys are short-lived creds issued for local load testing. They expire in 24 hours and allow higher burst (configurable up to 5x default). You can create one with the CLI: `rwd auth create-ephemeral --scopes=hosted:generate --ttl=24h`
emma: perfect, thanks. Any recommended client-side retry pattern?
maria: From security: use exponential backoff with jitter (e.g., base 200ms, factor 2, max 10s). Also rotate keys regularly and add them to the vault. Avoid storing keys in repo.
devex: Also remember header format for requests — example: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-sandbox-xxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","input":"hello"}'
```
emma: thanks! One more — are the hosted sandbox keys billed?
devex: Sandbox is free up to the quota. If you need more, the quota request form will route to billing/devex for approval. For production keys you will need a billing account and will be charged per-token.
emma: Great. I'll try the ephemeral flow for my experiment and file the form if needed. Thanks all :pray:
sam: Ping me if you need a temporary bump and include your thread link.
devex: If anyone else joining later needs onboarding, we have a short runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/dev-setup/sandbox-keys. Short TL;DR: console -> create sandbox key -> use vault -> follow retry pattern -> request increases through form.
emma: Saved the doc. Appreciate the fast help! :rocket:
devex: Welcome aboard again — @emma, slack us when you hit any blocker and we'll sort it.
